items.subtext: Laugh as helpless victims flee in terror fromtheir inevitable slaughter. The game basically plays itself.
Facefirm resistance from competent, determined enemies, but burn through enough ammo and you will eventaully triumph.
Fight against formidable foes that will truly test your skill and wits; this is the way Halo is meant to be played.
Tremble as teeming hordes of invincible alien monsters punish the slightest error with instant death... again and again.
